after: ## Central concepts and the learner portfolio
alt: Three areas of exploration, readers, writers and texts; time and space; and intertextuality: connecting texts, each 50 hours at SL and 80 at HL and each built from literary works only. Seven central concepts run across all three, and the learner portfolio underpins them.
caption: The same three areas as Language and Literature, filled only with literary works.

alt: SL students study at least 9 works: at least 4 originally written in the language studied, at least 3 in translation and 2 freely chosen. HL students study at least 13: 5, 4 and 4. A note records that the IB course webpage states 7 and 10.
caption: SL: at least 9 works; HL: at least 13, with works in translation at both levels.

alt: Paper 1, guided analysis, sets two unseen literary passages: SL students analyse one and HL students both. Paper 2 is a comparative essay on studied literary works. The individual oral pairs a work originally written in the language studied with a work studied in translation around a global issue. HL students also write an essay.
caption: Every component works from literary texts; Paper 1 tests close reading of unseen ones.
